verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's docs describe Klaviyo-maintained server-side SDKs for Python, PHP, Ruby, and Node, plus mobile SDKs for iOS, Android, React Native, and Flutter covering profile identification, event tracking, and push. Klaviyo Labs GitHub reference code and an importable API spec support building against them. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and in-depth SDK docs on typing, versioning, and coverage parity with the API.
